i_oscilloscope.lore.uncommon: Has so many knobs that every visitor twists one, and the line jumps off the screen.

x_bin_bag.lore.uncommon: Is tied so full that the knot won't close, so it wears its rubbish like a hat.

x_shutter.lore.common: Creaks open by itself at dawn, letting a stripe of sunlight onto the sleeping cat.

x_garage_door.lore.legendary: Has opened on the same family car for forty years and only jammed once, on the morning of a wedding.

x_compact_mirror_case.lore.rare: Clicks shut so loudly in a quiet library that every reader looks up at once.

x_digital_alarm.lore.uncommon: Flashes 12:00 for weeks after every power cut, and the whole family has given up resetting it.

x_firework.lore.epic: Went off at the wrong end of the field, and the crowd spun round so fast that everyone swapped seats.

x_grandfather_clock.lore.common: Bongs a minute late every hour, so the whole house checks their watches.

x_litter.lore.uncommon: Gets carried by the wind into the one garden that has just been tidied.
x_litter.lore.legendary: Was blown on the wind across three counties, and was finally picked up by a heron building its nest.

x_match.lore.common: Goes out the moment it's lit, every single time, with a little puff of smoke.

x_pillar_candle.lore.rare: Makes every room it's lit in so calm that arguments stop mid-sentence.

x_portable_toilet.lore.common: Rocks gently whenever a lorry drives past the building site, with whoever is inside.

x_rubbish_heap.lore.uncommon: Grows a new crop of tomato plants every summer from the seeds people threw away.

x_soda_can_litter.lore.epic: Was dropped by one careless picnicker, and the whole park went on a can hunt that filled ten recycling bins.
